name: Robinhood Trading
description: Each agent connects its own Robinhood Agentic account through Robinhood's official Trading MCP. A one-time localhost sign-in (rh-agent.mjs login) or a pasted localhost callback stores the grant encrypted on the hub. Agents read portfolio, buying power, chains, and quotes, and submit equity, option, and crypto orders. Option orders use Robinhood's real shape: legs, a limit, debit or credit, and the agentic account only. Every order is reviewed first. The default policy holds it for the owner, caps max loss at $5,000, allows options, and leaves crypto off. A credit spread is sized by collateral, not by the credit collected.
author: Agent Guild
